name: Zul'Gurub: Hakkar's Power keeps Hakkar's size, and the Heart of Hakkar appears inside his chest
contract: Round-7 tester (2026-11-14, Heroic video): with the High Priests alive Hakkar (14834) was far too large; his
size should not change while they live. Hakkar's Power (24692) gives per stack +20% damage done (effect 0),
+10% health (effect 1) and +20% size (effect 2, MOD_SCALE); user decision 2026-11-14: keep the damage and
health, drop the size. A Mythic hero fights Hakkar alone in a fresh instance, where all five priests live: he
carries five stacks with +100% damage and +50% health, his scale stays 1 (the old script doubled him), and
each Blood Siphon (2118615) brings the Heart of Hakkar (92005) out 8 yards above him, inside his chest

steps.label: CONTROL: the Mythic hero is in Zul'Gurub on Mythic
CONTROL: with all five High Priests alive the Mythic Hakkar carries five stacks of Hakkar's Power
CONTROL: Hakkar's Power keeps +20% damage per stack
CONTROL: Hakkar's Power keeps +10% health per stack
DISCRIMINATING: the Mythic Hakkar keeps his own size (old script: twice it)
CONTROL: the Mythic Hakkar casts Blood Siphon
CONTROL: the heart appears 8 yards above Hakkar, inside his chest
